Overview

The 2026 Toyota Camry ushers in the ninth generation of Toyota’s midsize sedan, now built exclusively on the TNGA-K platform with petrol and hybrid options. In the UAE it’s offered in three main trims, E, XLE, and GLE, in both petrol and hybrid form. The hybrid models pair a 2.5‑litre naturally aspirated engine with an electric motor and CVT, generating up to 227 hp and delivering up to 24 km/L fuel economy.

While the exterior retains Camry’s sleek roofline and bold fascia, the interior sees a major tech upgrade. Depending on trim, displays include a standard 8‑inch infotainment screen with Android Auto/Apple CarPlay, or a 12.3‑inch touchscreen. The GLE also boasts a fully digital 12.3‑inch driver cluster. Other features across trims include LED lights, dual‑zone climate control, and optional wireless charging.

All models include Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 with adaptive cruise control, lane departure alert, pre‑collision braking, and peace-of-mind passive...

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a 2026 Toyota Camry cost in UAE?

The base price of the 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE starts from AED 122,900 and goes all the way up to AED 152,000 for the highest trim.

What is the starting price of a 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The starting price of the 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE is AED 122,900.

How much is the top-spec 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The highest trim of the 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE is the Limited Hybrid and it costs AED 152,000.

What trims are available for the 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE is available in 7 trims. The trims are XLE, XLE Hybrid, GLE, Sport, GLE Hybrid, Sport Hybrid, and Limited Hybrid.

What are the engine options for the 2026 Toyota Camry?

The engine choices for the 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE are 2.5 I4 FWD, 2.5 H I4 FWD, 2.5 I4 FWD, 2.5 I4 FWD, 2.5 H I4 FWD, 2.5 H I4 FWD, and 2.5 I4 FWD.

What is the fuel efficiency (mileage) of the 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE delivers fuel economy of 16.9 km/l for the 2.5 I4 FWD, 27.8 km/l for the 2.5 H I4 FWD, 16.9 km/l for the 2.5 I4 FWD, 16.9 km/l for the 2.5 I4 FWD, 27.8 km/l for the 2.5 H I4 FWD, 27.8 km/l for the 2.5 H I4 FWD, and 16.9 km/l for the 2.5 I4 FWD.

How reliable is the 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The reliability of the 2026 Toyota Camry is rated 5 out of 5 stars in UAE.

What is the resale value of the 2026 Toyota Camry in UAE?

The resale value of the 2026 Toyota Camry is rated 5 out of 5 stars in UAE.
